title: Badge
description: A usage rule attached to a free resource. Badges drive the router's policy filters (Chapter 4.1 / 6.3).

type.description: age_18_plus: users must be adults. non_commercial: not for commercial/client work. trains_on_data: prompts may be used to improve the provider's products or reviewed by humans. eu_restricted: apps for EEA/CH/UK end users must not use this tier. manual_only: never automate (e.g. Colab). not_for_production: prototyping only. payment_method_required: a card must be added even for the free part. auto_renews_paid: the free period turns into a paid subscription automatically unless cancelled (shown as a red warning). educational_use_only: only for learning and teaching, stricter than non_commercial.
